_what: The recorded identity of the deployed artifact. Scripts read the namespace and the module names from here rather than restating them, so a gate cannot compare a constant with itself.

baccarat._module_hash_note: MEASURED on chain, never computed locally. A Pact 5 module hash covers its dependencies' hashes; baccarat depends on coin, and the test suite loads a vendored coin snapshot while mainnet runs a different coin — so a hash computed here will NEVER equal this one and proves nothing. VERIFY.md compares the CODE instead.

drand._module_hash_note: For THIS module a hash comparison is valid and is worth running: drand has no dependencies, holds no table and uses no other module, so the hash the REPL computes from pact/modules/drand.pact equals the one mainnet reports. It is also the literal baccarat pins in its `use`.
drand.governance: (enforce false) — sealed at deploy; it can never be upgraded
drand.deployed_for: roulette, on 2026-09-22; baccarat uses the same deployed module and deployed no verifier of its own

beacon._note: baccarat pins the verifier by hash in its `use`, so it cannot silently settle from different verifier code. pact/tests/baccarat-pin-must-fail.repl is the control that proves the pin bites.
